name: Shinomiya Ren
source:
2nd-year High School student. Member of the Kyudo Club. Kanade's childhood friend.

He's been playing with Kanade since they were little because he lives next door to him. He's very kind. His friendliness is adored by both men and women.

[From [url=http://honeyapple.html.xdomain.jp/game01/chara.html]official website[/url]]
